title: Engineer (Level II or III) - Power Grid Planning (Florida Transmission)
description:
Important Application Submission Information

In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Thursday, September 17, 2026

More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible ensuring the implementation of Transmission Planning activities in accordance with FERC, NERC and regional planning requirements. The successful candidate for this role is expected to develop the skills to perform work in areas specific to area planning, FERC/NERC compliance (i.e., Order 881, Order 1000, Order 1920, TPL-001), coordination with Florida utility peers through the regional planning organization, and supporting regulatory and rate case activities.

Employees at this level solve complex problems in engineering areas of specialization with general to limited supervision. Incumbents are expected to develop advanced skills, and the ability to work with greater independence. An Engineer at this level effectively applies fundamental concepts and procedures to work that is progressively complex and varied.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop the skills needed to perform steady state analysis of the Duke Energy Florida transmission system to verify reliability requirements are met.
  • Support compliance with all Transmission Planning-applicable NERC Reliability Standards and support the maintenance of documentation for compliance activities.
  • Support the development of filings for FERC Orders as well as provide comments on NOPRs.
  • Assist with FRCC regulatory and compliance efforts, interfacing with FRCC staff and FRCC members.
  • Ability to support compliance with all Florida Public Service Commission (FPSC) Transmission Planning requirements and apply relevant state laws and regulations.
  • Participate on inter-utility system working groups
  • Provide technical support to other areas of Transmission and the company on transmission planning related issues
  • Support the company's goals and represent the company in a positive professional manner at regional reliability team meetings

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Passing grade on the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Exam
  • Programming experience in areas such as Python, batch files, Visual Basic
  • Competence in engineering theories and principles
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience in the electric utility industry
  • Department specific experience applicable to Transmission Planning, NERC Compliance, FERC Compliance, or the OATT.
  • Ability to deal with a variety of individuals from various socio-economic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds.

Basic Qualifications

Note: This posting is for one open position. Dependent on relative experience, the level to which a candidate is aligned is outlined below.

Engineer II

  • Graduation from a four-year college or university with a Bachelor of Science in Engineering from an ABET accredited program. A Master's degree in engineering will be considered in lieu of the B. S. engineering degree.
  • Minimum of 2 years of engineering experience.

 Engineer III

  • Graduation from a four-year college or university with a Bachelor of Science in Engineering from an ABET accredited program. A Master's degree in engineering will be considered in lieu of the B. S. engineering degree.
  • Minimum of 4 years engineering experience

Working Conditions

  • Office Environment​
  • Hybrid Mobility Classification – Work will be performed from both remote and onsite locations after the onboarding period. However, employees should live within 50 miles, one way, of their designated Duke Energy facility.
  • Some travel (<10%) outside geographical area.
  • Onboarding requires employee to be onsite, then schedule is hybrid, typically 3 days in the office and the remainder from home each week.

Specific Requirements

  • Must have obtained Bachelor of Science in Engineering from an ABET accredited program.
  • A Master's degree in Engineering will be considered in lieu of the B.S. Engineering degree.
  • Support during emergency storm restoration, which could require extended hours working.
  • Valid Driver's License

Travel Requirements

5-15%

Relocation Assistance Provided (as applicable)

Yes

Represented/Union Position

No

Visa Sponsored Position

No. This is not a Visa Sponsored Position. This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.


Please note that in order to be considered for this position, you must possess all of the basic/required qualifications.
